text.aria-label: Title text 'Constructs of lagged and lagless heads against B-mix, signed-MW six Primaries (interim) Blue dot: mean over 5 months. Blue line: Bonferroni 95% interval from resampling whole months. Grey dots: single months. Dashed line: same as B-mix. K3-S1 mixes 3 S1 and 3 lagless heads.'
text.tspan: Constructs of lagged and lagless heads against B-mix, signed-MW six Primaries (interim)
Blue dot: mean over 5 months. Blue line: Bonferroni 95% interval from resampling whole months.
Grey dots: single months. Dashed line: same as B-mix. K3-S1 mixes 3 S1 and 3 lagless heads.
